content:
After recent hardware price hikes and subscription fee increases in the US and other markets, Apple has now raised iCloud+ prices in multiple countries. Here are the details.

Apple price hike wave continues

Apple raised subscription fees for Apple Music and Apple One in the US and other countries this week, and increased iPhone prices in Japan by up to 11%.

These price hikes come just days after Apple raised prices for MacBook, iPad, and other products in response to the ongoing memory shortage in the industry.

Now, Apple has once again announced price adjustments for iCloud+ in multiple markets. Below are the latest iCloud+ prices for affected markets (as of today):

Egypt (EGP)

  • 50 GB: £49.99 (originally £39.99)
  • 200 GB: £179.99 (originally £149.99)
  • 2 TB: £599.99 (originally £499.99)
  • 6 TB: £1799.99 (originally £1499.99)
  • 12 TB: £3599.99 (originally £2999.99)

Nigeria (NGN)

  • 50 GB: ₦1300 (originally ₦900)
  • 200 GB: ₦4500 (originally ₦2900)
  • 2 TB: ₦14900 (originally ₦9900)
  • 6 TB: ₦39900 (originally ₦26900)
  • 12 TB: ₦66900 (originally ₦44900)

Turkey (TRY)

  • 50 GB: 49.99 lira (originally 39.99 lira)
  • 200 GB: 169.99 lira (originally 129.99 lira)
  • 2 TB: 549.99 lira (originally 399.99 lira)
  • 6 TB: 1699.99 lira (originally 1299.99 lira)
  • 12 TB: 3399.99 lira (originally 2499.99 lira)

Indonesia (IDR)

  • 50 GB: 15,000 Indonesian rupiah (price unchanged)
  • 200 GB: 59,000 Indonesian rupiah (originally 49,000 Indonesian rupiah)
  • 2 TB: 199,000 Indonesian rupiah (originally 169,000 Indonesian rupiah)
  • 6 TB: 599,000 Indonesian rupiah (originally 499,000 Indonesian rupiah)
  • 12 TB: 1,199,000 Indonesian rupiah (originally 999,000 Indonesian rupiah)

Japan (JPY)

  • 50 GB: ¥180 (originally ¥150)
  • 200 GB: ¥540 (originally ¥450)
  • 2 TB: ¥1800 (originally ¥1500)
  • 6 TB: ¥5500 (originally ¥4500)
  • 12 TB: ¥11000 (originally ¥9000)

New Zealand (NZD)

  • 50 GB: NZ$1.99 (originally NZ$1.69)
  • 200 GB: NZ$5.99 (originally NZ$4.99)
  • 2 TB: NZ$19.99 (originally NZ$16.99)
  • 6 TB: NZ$59.99 (originally NZ$49.99)
  • 12 TB: NZ$119.99 (originally NZ$99.99)

Philippines (PHP)

  • 50 GB: ₱59 (originally ₱49)
  • 200 GB: ₱199 (originally ₱179)
  • 2 TB: ₱699 (originally ₱599)
  • 6 TB: ₱1990 (originally ₱1790)
  • 12 TB: ₱3990 (originally ₱3590)

Vietnam (VND)

  • 50 GB: ₫25000 (originally ₫19000)
  • 200 GB: ₫89000 (originally ₫69000)
  • 2 TB: ₫299000 (originally ₫249000)
  • 6 TB: ₫899000 (originally ₫749000)
  • 12 TB: ₫1799000 (originally ₫1499000)

In addition, Apple is now adding Laos, Mauritius, and the Republic of the Congo as new regions billed in US dollars (USD), noting that "prices may be slightly higher than other regions due to value-added tax (VAT) requirements."

iCloud+ prices for the aforementioned regions are as follows:

Mauritius (USD)

  • 50 GB: US$1.19
  • 200 GB: US$3.49
  • 2 TB: US$11.99
  • 6 TB: US$34.99
  • 12 TB: US$69.99

  • 50 GB: US$1.19

  • 12 TB: US$69.99

  • 2 TB: US$10.99
  • 6 TB: US$32.99
  • 12 TB: US$64.99
